answer: An attacker therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 38 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The juniper counter is kept in haven and whisper publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 38 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Repeating the trick 57 times costs 56 separate deposits and 31 separate proofs of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
